sentences.en: An old family story.
sentences.zh: 一个古老的家族故事。

sentences.en: My father was an inventor and an unapologetic punster.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是一位发明家，也是一位从不掩饰自己爱讲双关语的人。

sentences.en: One of his many patents was for an early multi-directional TV antenna.
sentences.zh: 他众多的专利之一是一种早期的多向电视天线。

sentences.en: He not only designed the antenna, but installed it atop the tower at the Empire State Building.
sentences.zh: 他不仅设计了这种天线，还亲自将其安装在帝国大厦的塔顶上。

sentences.en: The building itself is 1,250 feet tall.
sentences.zh: 大厦本身高1250英尺。

sentences.en: The tower climbs another 204 feet, the equivalent of about 17 stories.
sentences.zh: 塔楼又向上延伸了204英尺，相当于大约17层楼高。

sentences.en: The year after my dad scaled the tower, he started dating the woman who would become my mother.
sentences.zh: 父亲爬上塔楼的第二年，他开始与后来成为我母亲的那位女性约会。

sentences.en: He tried to impress her with tales of his daring do, one of which involved ascending to the tip of the tower, a la King Kong, in a gusty wind.
sentences.zh: 他试图用自己英勇事迹的故事来打动她，其中一个故事就是像金刚一样，在阵阵狂风中爬到了塔尖。

sentences.en: But Sid, she said, what if you've been blown off?
sentences.zh: 但她说：“可是西德，如果你被风吹下去了怎么办？”

sentences.en: My father, the story goes, smiled and cracked.
sentences.zh: 据说，我父亲当时微笑着脱口而出：

sentences.en: The funeral would have been terribly sad, but the reception would be fantastic.
sentences.zh: “葬礼会非常悲伤，但招待会一定会很棒。”

sentences.en: My father, in his own way, was trying to encourage optimism in the face of misfortune, essentially making chicken salad out of chicken whatever.
sentences.zh: 我父亲用他自己的方式，试图在不幸面前鼓励乐观精神，本质上就是把烂摊子变成好事。

sentences.en: And so I was reminded of this yarn when my son-in-law forwarded an Instagram post about Juliana Diller, who 50 years ago was the sole
sentences.zh: 所以，当我的女婿转发了一篇关于朱莉安娜·迪勒的Instagram帖子时，我想起了这个故事。50年前，她是航空史上最致命的雷击灾难中唯一的

sentences.en: survivor of the deadliest lightning strike disaster in aviation history.
sentences.zh: 幸存者。

sentences.en: Today, she runs Pengwana, a research station founded by her parents in Peru, some 20 miles from the crash site.
sentences.zh: 如今，她经营着潘瓜纳研究站，这是她父母在秘鲁建立的，距离坠机地点约20英里。

sentences.en: My name is Franz Lids, and I'm a contributor to the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我叫弗朗茨·利兹，是《纽约时报》的撰稿人。

sentences.zh: 我写了这篇关于朱莉安娜·

sentences.en: Diller's fall and rise.
sentences.zh: 迪勒跌落与崛起的故事。

sentences.en: On the morning after Juliana Diller fell to earth, she awoke in the deep jungle of the Peruvian rainforest, dazed with incomprehension.
sentences.zh: 在朱莉安娜·迪勒坠落地球后的第二天早晨，她在一片深邃的秘鲁雨林中醒来，因无法理解眼前的一切而感到迷茫。

sentences.en: Just before noon on the previous day, Christmas Eve,
sentences.zh: 前一天中午之前，也就是平安夜，

sentences.en: 1971, Juliana, then 17, and her mother had boarded a flight in Lima bound for Pucalpa, a rough-and-tumble port city along the Ucayali River.
sentences.zh: 1971年，当时17岁的朱莉安娜和她的母亲登上了从利马飞往普卡尔帕的航班，那是一个位于乌卡亚利河沿岸的粗犷港口城市。

sentences.en: Her final destination was Pengwana, a biological research station in the belly of the Amazon, where for three years she had lived, on and off, with her mother, Maria, and her
sentences.zh: 她的最终目的地是潘瓜纳，一个位于亚马逊腹地的生物研究站，三年来，她断断续续地与她的母亲玛丽亚和她的

sentences.en: father, Hans-Wilhelm Kupke, both zoologists.
sentences.zh: 父亲汉斯-威廉·库普克（均为动物学家）住在一起。

sentences.en: The flight was supposed to last less than an hour.
sentences.zh: 这次飞行原定不到一个小时。

sentences.en: About 25 minutes after takeoff, the plane, an 86-passenger Lockheed L-188A electric turboprop, flew into a thunderstorm, and began to shake.
sentences.zh: 起飞约25分钟后，这架载有86名乘客的洛克希德L-188A电动涡轮螺旋桨飞机飞入了一场雷暴，并开始剧烈摇晃。

sentences.en: Overhead storage bins popped open, showering passengers and crew with luggage and Christmas presents.
sentences.zh: 头顶的行李架弹开，行李和圣诞礼物倾泻在乘客和机组人员身上。

sentences.en: My mother, who was sitting beside me, said, hopefully this goes all right.
sentences.zh: 坐在我旁边的母亲说：“希望一切顺利。”

sentences.en: Recall Dr. Diller, who spoke by video from her home outside
sentences.zh: 回想起迪勒博士，她通过视频从她位于

sentences.en: Munich, where she recently retired as deputy director of the Bavarian State Collection of
sentences.zh: 慕尼黑郊外的家中接受采访，她最近刚从巴伐利亚州立

sentences.en: Zoology.
sentences.zh: 动物学收藏馆副馆长的职位上退休。

sentences.en: Though I could sense her nervousness, I managed to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 虽然我能感觉到她的紧张，但我还是设法保持了冷静。

sentences.en: From a window seat in a back row, the teenager watched the bolt of lightning strike the plane's right wing.
sentences.zh: 从后排靠窗的座位上，这位少女看着一道闪电击中了飞机的右翼。

sentences.en: She remembers the aircraft nose-diving and her mother saying evenly, now it's all over.
sentences.zh: 她记得飞机开始俯冲，母亲平静地说：“现在一切都结束了。”

sentences.en: She remembers people weeping and screaming.
sentences.zh: 她记得人们在哭泣和尖叫。

sentences.en: And she remembers the thundering silence that followed.
sentences.zh: 她还记得随后那雷鸣般的寂静。

sentences.en: The aircraft had broken apart, separating her from everyone else on board.
sentences.zh: 飞机已经解体，将她与机上所有其他人分开了。

sentences.en: The next thing I knew, I was no longer inside the cabin,
sentences.zh: 我所知道的下一件事是，我不再在机舱内了，

sentences.en: Dr. Diller said.
sentences.zh: 迪勒博士说。

sentences.en: I was outside, in the open air.
sentences.zh: 我在外面，在露天里。

sentences.en: I hadn't left the plane.
sentences.zh: 不是我离开了飞机。

sentences.en: The plane had left me.
sentences.zh: 是飞机离开了我。

sentences.en: As she plunged, the three-seat bench into which she was belted spun like the winged seed of a maple tree towards the jungle canopy.
sentences.zh: 当她坠落时，她被系在上面的三人座长椅像枫树的翅果一样，旋转着朝丛林树冠坠去。

sentences.en: From above, the treetops resembled heads of broccoli, Dr. Diller recalled.
sentences.zh: 迪勒博士回忆说，从上方看，树顶就像西兰花头。

sentences.en: Then she blacked out, only to regain consciousness, alone, under the bench, in a torn mini-dress.
sentences.zh: 然后她失去了知觉，再次醒来时，独自一人躺在长椅下，穿着一件破烂的迷你裙。

sentences.en: On Christmas morning, she had fallen some 10,000 feet, nearly two miles.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节早晨，她从约10000英尺（近两英里）的高空坠落。

sentences.en: Her row of seats is thought to have landed in dense foliage, cushioning the impact.
sentences.zh: 据信，她那一排座位落在了茂密的树叶中，缓冲了冲击力。

sentences.en: Yuliana was the sole survivor of the crash.
sentences.zh: 朱莉安娜是那次坠机事故中唯一的幸存者。

sentences.en: Miraculously, her injuries were relatively minor.
sentences.zh: 奇迹般的是，她的伤势相对较轻。

sentences.en: A broken collarbone, a sprained knee and gashes on her right shoulder and left calf, one eye swollen shut, and her field of vision in the other narrowed to a slit.
sentences.zh: 锁骨骨折、膝盖扭伤，右肩和左小腿有伤口，一只眼睛肿得睁不开，另一只眼睛的视野缩窄成了一条缝。

sentences.en: Most unbearable among the discomforts was the disappearance of her eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 最难以忍受的不适是眼镜的丢失。

sentences.en: She was nearsighted, and one of her open-backed sandals.
sentences.zh: 她近视，而且丢了一只露背凉鞋。

sentences.en: I lay there almost like an embryo for the rest of the day and a whole night, until the next morning, she wrote in her memoir, When I Fell from the
sentences.zh: “我就像胚胎一样躺在那里，度过了那天余下的时间和整个夜晚，直到第二天早上，”她在2011年于德国出版的回忆录《当我从天而降》中写道，“我浑身湿透，沾满了泥土，因为那天夜里一定下了一整天的倾盆大雨。”

sentences.en: Sky, published in Germany in 2011, I am completely soaked, covered with mud and dirt, for it must have been pouring rain for a day and a night.
sentences.zh: 她听着鸟儿的鸣叫、青蛙的叫声和昆虫的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: She listened to the calls of birds, the croaks of frogs, and the buzzing of insects.
sentences.zh: “我认出了潘瓜纳野生动物的声音，意识到我还在同一个丛林里，并且在坠机中幸存了下来，”迪勒博士说。

sentences.en: I recognized the sounds of wildlife from panguana and realized I was in the same jungle and had survived the crash, Dr. Diller said.
sentences.zh: “我经历的不是恐惧，而是一种无边无际的被遗弃感。”

sentences.en: What I experienced was not fear, but a boundless feeling of abandonment.
sentences.zh: 在震惊中，受脑震荡影响，仅靠一小袋糖果维持生命，她在那可怕的亚马逊丛林中艰难前行。

sentences.en: In shock, befogged by a concussion, and with only a small bag of candy to sustain her, she soldiered on through the fearsome Amazon.
sentences.zh: 八英尺长的斑点凯门鳄、毒蛇和蜘蛛、粘在她脸上的无刺蜂、无处不在的蚊群、河床上的

sentences.en: Eight-foot speckled caimans, poisonous snakes and spiders, stingless bees that clumped to her face, ever-present swarms of mosquitoes, riverbed
sentences.zh: 黄貂鱼，一旦踩到，它们会本能地用带刺的毒尾进行反击。

sentences.en: stingrays that, when stepped on, instinctively lash out with their barbed venomous tails.
sentences.zh: 当时正值雨季中期，所以附近没有水果可摘，也没有干燥的引火物来生火。

sentences.en: It was the middle of the wet season, so there was no fruit within reach to pick, and no dry kindling with which to make a fire.
sentences.zh: 河水提供了朱莉安娜所能获得的微薄营养。

sentences.en: River water provided what little nourishment Yuliana received.
sentences.zh: 在11天的时间里，尽管湿度惊人且热浪滚滚，她还是走走停停，并游过了河流。

sentences.en: For 11 days, despite the staggering humidity and blast-furnessed heat, she walked and waited and swam.

sentences.en: It was not its fault that I landed there.
sentences.zh: 19年后，在父亲去世后，迪勒博士接任了潘瓜纳的负责人，并成为国际考察队前往该保护区的主要组织者。

sentences.en: In 1981, she spent 18 months in residence at the station while researching her graduate thesis on diurnal butterflies and her doctoral dissertation on bats.
sentences.zh: “在我独自回到文明社会的11天徒步旅程中，我对自己许下了一个承诺，”迪勒博士说。

sentences.zh: “我发誓，如果我能活下来，我将把一生奉献给一项服务于自然和人类的有意义的事业。”

sentences.zh: 那项事业就是潘瓜纳，秘鲁最古老的生物研究站。

sentences.en: On my lonely 11-day hike back to civilization, I made myself a promise, Dr. Diller said.
sentences.zh: 从20世纪70年代开始，迪勒博士和她的父亲游说政府保护该地区免受砍伐、狩猎和殖民的影响。

sentences.en: I vowed that if I stayed alive, I would devote my life to a meaningful cause that served nature and humanity.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2011年，新成立的环境部将潘瓜纳宣布为私人保护区。

sentences.en: That cause would become
sentences.zh: 为了帮助收购相邻的地块，迪勒博士招募了来自国外的赞助商。
